## Minneapolis holiday-party planning summary

### Bar / wine-and-liquor service shortlist
These are practical Twin Cities options to contact for availability, bar format, minimums, and venue-specific licensing requirements:

- **Surdyk’s Catering — Minneapolis, MN.** Full-service food-and-beverage caterer with wine, beer, spirits, and Sidebar signature cocktails. [Full-service details](https://www.surdykscatering.com/full-service-catering)
- **Steady Pour — Minneapolis, MN.** Off-site bartending and bar catering; it states that it holds an Alcohol Caterer’s Permit and can offer hosted, partially hosted, cash-bar, client-provided-alcohol, signature-cocktail, and nonalcoholic-specialty-cocktail formats. [Bar-catering details](https://www.steadypour.com/bar-catering)
- **Bootleg Blondie Mobile Bar — Minneapolis, MN.** Minnesota-based mobile beverage caterer specializing in handcrafted cocktails and mocktails, with a full-service bar brought to the event.
- **LiquidMotion Insured Bartending Service — Robbinsdale, MN.** Mobile bartending service serving the Minneapolis–St. Paul area, geared to weddings and private events.
- **With A Twist Bartending Service — Fridley, MN.** Twin Cities mobile bartender/cocktail-server provider for parties and events; its Minneapolis service describes a fully catered bartending service. [Service information](https://twistbartendingservice.com/mn)
- **One More Bartending LLC — Buffalo, MN.** Portable, insured bartending service for weddings, parties, corporate events, and holiday gatherings; it says it can handle setup, serving, and cleanup.

**Surdyk’s clarification:** it is clearly more than a bartender-only option. Its verified full-service offering includes (1) cocktail-style food such as antipasti stations and inventive hors d’oeuvres, (2) buffet dinners, (3) comprehensive wine/beer/spirits service selected by its team plus Sidebar cocktails, and (4) menu planning, staffing, and rental coordination. It also offers drop-off catering, including party platters, small bites, warm mains, sandwiches/entrée salads, sides, sweets, and beverages. That makes it a strong single-vendor candidate if you want party food *and* a complete beverage program rather than bar labor alone.

### Nonalcoholic menu option: Instant Pot mulligatawny
A reliable choice is Robin Donovan’s [**Instant Pot Mulligatawny Soup**](https://allwaysdelicious.com/instant-pot-mulligatawny-soup-easy-and-delicious/) at *All Ways Delicious*. It is vegetarian and can be vegan if made with oil rather than butter/ghee; it makes 10 servings.

- **Key ingredients:** oil, onion, carrots, fresh chile, garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin, paprika, cinnamon, turmeric, apples, diced tomatoes, red lentils, brown basmati rice, vegetable broth, full-fat coconut milk, and cilantro; optional caramelized cashews and raisins. 
- **Basic method:** sauté onion and carrot; add chile, garlic, ginger, and spices; stir in apples and tomatoes, then lentils, rice, and broth. Seal and pressure-cook on high for 10 minutes, quick-release, partially blend, then stir in coconut milk and garnish. The recipe lists about 50 minutes total (including prep and pressure time).

For any alcohol service, confirm that the chosen provider can serve at your exact venue and under its applicable permit: Minneapolis states caterers serving alcohol need a liquor caterer’s license/permit.
